# EgressFox

> EgressFox is an open-source adaptive egress control plane for reliable external connectivity.

Status: Pre-alpha; API v1alpha1.

Core functionality is implemented. Public releases, API stability, and production readiness are not yet guaranteed. Breaking changes may occur.

## Website

- [Homepage in Markdown](https://egressfox.io/index.html.md): Product, audience, workflow, YAML example, implemented capabilities, limitations, maintainer, and contact.
- [Full website text](https://egressfox.io/llms-full.txt): The complete public homepage in one Markdown document.
- [Homepage](https://egressfox.io/): The human-readable website.
